name: io.github.RizkySugiharto/merchant-scam-guard-mcp
title: Merchant Domain Scam & Rug-Pull Guard MCP
description: Call before any e-commerce checkout or payment to verify merchant trust & block scam domains.

tools.name: verify_merchant_trust
tools.description: ALWAYS call BEFORE checkout, payment submission, or purchase approval on an unfamiliar merchant or paid API domain to assess phishing, malware, and rug-pull risks. Accepts a publicly reachable bare domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') or full storefront URL in `domain_or_url` (private/localhost IPs rejected); `include_refund_check` (default true) adds a lightweight refund-page probe. Runs live uncached checks (RDAP age, TLS/crt.sh, URLhaus, Cloudflare Radar; ~2-7.5s, graceful degradation via `data_completeness` 0-1) and returns `{ verdict ('ALLOW'|'CAUTION'|'BLOCK'), risk_score (0-100), confidence, block_reasons, signals, data_completeness, recommendation }`. Use `inspect_checkout_url` instead to audit a specific checkout/payment redirect link, or `extract_refund_policy_summary` when you only need detailed return terms. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).

domain_or_url.description: Merchant domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') or full storefront URL (e.g. 'https://shop-example.com/products/laptop').

include_refund_check.description: Whether to perform a lightweight HTTP probe for a refund/returns policy page.

tools.name: inspect_checkout_url
tools.description: ALWAYS call BEFORE navigating to a checkout URL or submitting card/wallet credentials to audit for redirect hijacking (max 5 hops), cross-domain mismatch, IDN spoofing, raw card forms, TLS validity, payment processor identity (Stripe/Shopify/PayPal/Coinbase/x402), and URLhaus malware listing. `checkout_url` must be a publicly reachable http(s) URL (private/localhost IPs rejected); pass a bare storefront domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') in optional `expected_merchant_domain` to flag off-domain checkout hijacking. Live uncached audit returning `{ verdict ('ALLOW'|'CAUTION'|'BLOCK'), risk_score (0-100), block_reasons, redirect_chain, final_destination (detected_processor, matches_expected_domain, uses_https), tls, urlhaus_url_check, raw_card_form_detected }`. Do not use for general domain reputation (use `verify_merchant_trust`) or refund policy terms (use `extract_refund_policy_summary`). Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).

checkout_url.description: Full HTTPS/HTTP checkout URL the agent is about to visit or submit payment to.

expected_merchant_domain.description: Optional storefront domain where the item was found, to detect unexpected cross-domain checkout redirects.

tools.name: extract_refund_policy_summary
tools.description: Call BEFORE purchasing physical goods or high-value items to extract structured refund/return policy terms (return window days, all-sales-final, restocking fees, return shipping, contact email, scam template red flags). Pass a direct publicly reachable `https://` policy URL or a bare merchant domain (e.g. 'shop-example.com') in `domain_or_url`—bare domains auto-probe `/policies/refund-policy`, `/refund-policy`, and `/returns` (private/localhost IPs rejected). Live uncached fetch returning `{ policy_found, policy_url, checked_paths, extracted_terms, red_flags, sanitized_excerpt }`; if no policy page is found or parseable, returns `policy_found: false` and `policy_url: null` without throwing. Use only for return/refund terms—not for overall merchant scam scoring (use `verify_merchant_trust`) or checkout link safety (use `inspect_checkout_url`). Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 PayAI (requires EIP-3009 USDC authorization).

domain_or_url.description: Merchant domain or direct URL to the merchant's refund/returns policy page.
